description: Returns SEC Form 13F holdings: the quarterly long-equity positions of every institutional investment manager that files a 13F ($100M+ in 13(f) securities), whole books, every quarter since 2013-06-30. Each record is one (fund, security, quarter).  Use this when the user asks which institutions hold a stock, what a fund owns, how a position changed quarter over quarter, or about "whale" activity in a name.  Freshness: 13Fs are due 45 days after quarter end. Every 13F on EDGAR's daily list is normally loaded within a day of filing, deadline days included, and some sooner (EDGAR is also checked every 4 hours) (loaded_from "edgar"). Quarters covered by SEC's quarterly 13F data sets come from them (loaded_from "sec_dataset").  13F does NOT include short positions, cash, most options, or non-US-listed equities.  position_change ('new', 'increased', 'decreased', 'closed', 'unchanged') is measured against the same fund's whole prior-quarter book. Amendments are applied as filed: a RESTATEMENT replaces the report; a NEW HOLDINGS amendment adds to it, and a security it lists again is shown once at the sum, with combined_accessions naming every filing in it. form is '13F-HR' or '13F-HR/A'; amendment_type is 'RESTATEMENT', 'NEW HOLDINGS', or null.  issuer_name is the security's registered name where known, otherwise the name 13F filers report for it. A ticker query follows the security (its CUSIP) across a ticker change, so older quarters are included (query.resolved_cusips lists the CUSIPs matched); on those older rows the ticker shown may be the security's current one.  Values are US dollars. Filings before 2023 reported thousands and are multiplied by 1000. A filing that used the other unit is corrected once market prices confirm it (units_corrected true; value_as_filed holds the filed number). Where the units could not be confirmed, market_value is null, value_as_filed holds the number as filed, units_note says why, and the row is left out of value sorts and min_value.  portfolio_weight_pct is the position's share of the fund's total reported value that quarter. verification_status VERIFIED means the filing matches its own declared row count and total value: a consistency check, not a price check. INSUFFICIENT_DATA means that check failed or could not run, or the filing's values do not fit market prices (for example a garbled table).  Give at least one filter that narrows the search: a fund (fund_cik or fund_name), a security (ticker or cusip), or a quarter. With no filter at all, the answer is the latest complete quarter (query.quarter says which). sort_by shares_held or shares_change_pct needs a quarter plus a fund or a security; position_change needs a fund or a security. Otherwise the call answers FILTER_REQUIRED and names the filter to add.

cursor.description: Pass the `next_cursor` from the previous response VERBATIM to fetch the next page. Keep every other filter and the sort identical while paging. Omit to start from the top. A quarter of 13F filings runs to far more than 500 rows, so a complete picture requires paging.

cusip.description: Alternative to ticker — 9-character SEC CUSIP identifier. Useful when a security has multiple share classes with different tickers.

fund_cik.description: SEC CIK of the fund (10-digit, padded). Preferred over fund_name when known. Berkshire Hathaway = '0001067983'.

fund_name.description: Full or partial fund name, at least 3 characters; case-insensitive, and it matches every name the manager has filed under (query.resolved_fund_ciks lists the managers). A name matching more than 20 managers answers FILTER_REQUIRED; use fund_cik. Examples: 'Berkshire', 'Bridgewater', 'Citadel'.

limit.description: Maximum records to return. Default 50, max 500.

min_value.description: Filter to positions with market_value >= this amount (USD). Use to focus on large positions.

position_change.description: Filter to position-change type. Common queries: 'increased' for funds adding to a position, 'closed' for funds that exited.

quarter.description: Period end, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. '2026-03-31'). With a fund or security and no quarter, every quarter is returned; with no filter at all, the latest complete quarter.

sort_by.description: Field used for ordering. Default: market_value (largest positions first). shares_held and shares_change_pct need a quarter plus a fund or security.

ticker.description: Filter to holdings of one stock by US ticker, e.g. 'AAPL'. Case-insensitive. Follows the security across a ticker change.

name: get_institutional_holdings
